changes: Updated `src/slugify.py` to use whitespace-aware splitting and joining.
Leading/trailing whitespace is removed, consecutive whitespace collapses to one hyphen, whitespace-only values return `""`, and punctuation remains unchanged.
arguments.rationale: Python's `split()` without a separator recognizes all Unicode whitespace and discards empty edge fields; joining the resulting tokens with hyphens provides the requested behavior without altering punctuation.
arguments.root_cause: The previous implementation split only on literal spaces, so other whitespace and repeated spaces were not normalized correctly.
